class.name: MeshND
class.description: MeshND is the base class for all ND meshes. Meshes are used to represent the visuals of objects in ND space. All ND meshes have rect bounds, a dimension, validation, and a proxy mesh for representing the mesh in 3D-based rendering engines. For a wireframe-only mesh, use [WireMeshND] or one of its descendants. Meshes may also have simplex cells, which are the equivalent of triangles in 3D meshes. For a simplex cell mesh, use [CellMeshND] or one of its descendants. Advanced users can create custom mesh classes by extending the appropriate class.

method.name: _update_proxy_mesh_3d
method.description: Callback method that should rebuild the proxy 3D mesh associated with this mesh. Do not call this method. This can be overridden by derived classes when creating a custom mesh type in GDScript or another scripting language. See [method update_proxy_mesh_3d] for details.

method.name: _validate_material_for_mesh
method.description: Callback method that should validate a material for a mesh, ensuring that the material is suitable for rendering the mesh. Do not call this method. This can be overridden by derived classes when creating a custom mesh type in GDScript or another scripting language. See [method validate_material_for_mesh] for details of the input and output.

method.name: _validate_mesh_data
method.description: Callback method that should validate the mesh data. Do not call this method. This can be overridden by derived classes when creating a custom mesh type in GDScript or another scripting language. This method should return [code]true[/code] if the mesh data is valid, and [code]false[/code] if it is not. If the mesh data is invalid, the mesh will be skipped when rendering.

method.name: deduplicate_edge_indices
method.description: Static helper method for deduplicating edge indices. This method ensures that each pair of two integers in the array is unique, and that the first index is less than the second index. This is useful for optimizing wireframe meshes by removing duplicate edges and ensuring a consistent order for each edge. [b]Note[/b]: This only looks at edge indices. It does not remove duplicate vertices, nor does it have access to the vertices array.

method.name: get_dimension
method.description: Returns the dimension of the mesh. For array meshes, this is the number of components in the first vertex position, or zero if there are no vertices. Other positions may omit trailing zero components, but must not have more components than the mesh dimension. For [CellMeshND], the amount of indices making up a simplex cell is usually equal to the dimension.

method.name: get_proxy_mesh_3d
method.description: Returns the proxy 3D mesh associated with this mesh. The proxy mesh is lazily created on the first call and regenerated by [method update_proxy_mesh_3d] whenever it has been marked dirty, so repeated calls are cheap and always return the same [ArrayMesh] instance. [b]Note:[/b] The ND module does not have a renderer that uses this proxy mesh yet, so the base implementation leaves it empty unless a derived class overrides [method _update_proxy_mesh_3d] to fill it in.

method.name: get_rect_bounds
method.description: Returns the [RectND] bounds of the mesh in local space, computed by expanding a rect to include every vertex, and always including the mesh's local origin even if the mesh's geometry does not cover that point. The result is cached until [method mark_mesh_bounds_and_proxy_mesh_3d_dirty] is called, so repeated calls are cheap.

method.name: is_mesh_data_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the mesh data is valid. This method checks if the data in a mesh is valid for rendering. If the mesh data is invalid, the mesh will be skipped when rendering. This method is called internally by the rendering server, but may also be called manually. If a mesh has valid data, the result of the validation will be cached until the mesh data changes, so this method may be called multiple times without performance concerns. This also means this method should be called after generating a mesh. This especially useful when generating a mesh on a thread; calling this on the thread will avoid stalling the main thread with mesh validation during rendering.

method.name: mark_mesh_bounds_and_proxy_mesh_3d_dirty
method.description: Marks the mesh bounds and the proxy 3D mesh as dirty, meaning they need to be updated. Must be called by subclasses whenever the underlying ND mesh data changes. This implies [method mark_proxy_mesh_3d_dirty], so there is no need to also call that method when calling this one.

method.name: mark_proxy_mesh_3d_dirty
method.description: Marks the proxy 3D mesh as dirty, meaning it needs to be updated. Must be called by subclasses whenever the underlying ND mesh data changes.

method.name: reset_mesh_data_validation
method.description: Resets the validation state of the mesh data. This method clears the cached validation state of the mesh data, so that the next call to [method is_mesh_data_valid] will revalidate the mesh data. This is useful when the mesh data has changed and you want to ensure that the mesh is revalidated before rendering. This will be called automatically on built-in types such as [ArrayWireMeshND] when the mesh data changes.

method.name: update_proxy_mesh_3d
method.description: Rebuilds the proxy 3D mesh associated with this mesh. Can be called to force the proxy mesh to be updated, but typically should only be called internally by [method get_proxy_mesh_3d].

method.name: validate_material_for_mesh
method.description: Validates that the given material can be used for this mesh. This method may alter the material data if needed to make it compatible with the mesh. For example, if the material has per-edge colors, it will ensure that the color array is at least as big as the amount of edges in the mesh. This method is called automatically when running [method MeshInstanceND.get_active_material], but may also be called manually.
